City of Dalaran: The Magic barrier around Dalaran has fallen, and the city of mages is overrun. Once the seat of the Kirin Tor and their great libraries, it was ravaged in the Third War by Arthas and then destroyed by Archimonde. Clear out the threats that remain.
The Hall of Thanes: Hidden beneath the High Seat of Ironforge, the Hall of Thanes is the resting place of the legendary dwarves of the Eastern Kingdoms. Now the Dark Iron dwarves have invaded it, and it is part of the old Ironforge that was sealed away until Forever.
Krol'dok Stronghold: The capital of the Krol'dok ogre clan rises over the Riverglades. The ogres are joined by the Twilight's Hammer and the Shadowhide gnolls, who want to take the Riverglades from the Bolderok ogres and the Brotherhood of the Horse.
Excavation Site: Wetlands: The Explorer's League, archaeologists studying the origins of the dwarven race, has a camp in the Wetlands at Whelgar's Excavation Site, overrun with raptors. Strange activity to the southeast has revealed a titan site, and a new camp was set up to explore it.
The Drowned City: The fabled lost troll city of I'lalai is finally found. The last trolls live there among the Saltseer Pirates, and the magical corruption of the Kurzen Compounds has spread through it. Adventurers must stop the dangers within.
Blackmaw Hold: The Blackmaw furbolgs, rivals of the Timbermaw clan, have made a pact with the demonic Legashi satyrs. Together they are corrupting Azshara with fel magic from their stronghold, Blackmaw Hold. Help the Timbermaw put a stop to them.
Alcaz Prison: A hidden prison on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh. After Theramore members aligned with the Defias Brotherhood, the missing King Varian Wrynn is believed to be held here. The Alliance seeks its lost king while others have their own plans for the prison.
Ruins of Lordaeron: The ruins of Lordaeron still hold the Scourge from the Third War, haunting the Forsaken of Tirisfal Glades. Push back the Lich King's army from the ruined capital before it spreads further.
The Shaper's Terrace: A terrace of the Shapers, a forgotten people, in Un'Goro Crater. Their old workings hold the threats that now stir in the crater.
